The Triton story

Formerly Sanvi Group and headquartered in Bengaluru, Triton was founded by homebuyers, for homebuyers. For 13 years we have built communities on one belief: a home should be a family’s most rewarding decision, never its biggest compromise.

“Each Triton development is carefully placed in promising growth corridors across India, where connectivity, infrastructure, and lifestyle demand create long-term value.”

Triton Group is a premium real estate developer headquartered in Bengaluru, focused on North Bengaluru’s high-growth corridors. Built on Sanvi’s development legacy, the group has 13+ years of delivery, 10,000+ customers and 1,000+ acres planned and developed across villas, apartments and commercial land.

Triton Group was founded by Mr. Kishore Babu, Mr. Harish Naidu, and Mr. Uppara Nagaraju. The team is led by IIM alumni, engineers and experienced real estate professionals.

Triton Group develops premium residential communities including luxury villas and modern apartment projects in Bengaluru’s emerging growth corridors, along with commercial land developments across North Bangalore.

Triton developments are strategically located in high-growth areas of North and East Bengaluru, close to major infrastructure, employment hubs, and connectivity corridors such as the airport corridor and Nandi Hills.

Yes. Triton projects comply with applicable regulations, and RERA/CUDA registration details are available for eligible projects. Triton Humming Valley is registered under PRM/KA/RERA/1254/460/PR/131224/007292.

Triton Humming Valley is a boutique collection of Bali-inspired 3, 4 & 5 BHK luxury villas between Nandi Hills and Chandragiri Hills. Prices start from ₹2.4 Cr, with 2,680 – 4,448 sq ft super built-up area and possession in December 2026.

Every villa rises three levels with a lift to every floor, a 15 ft indoor waterfall, a roof terrace with a private jacuzzi, a bar counter and a covered car porch, with panoramic valley views.

Sanvi Aero Gardens offers premium 1, 2 & 3 BHK apartments in the North Bengaluru airport corridor, near tech parks and aerospace hubs. Prices start from ₹68 Lakhs (all included), with 625 – 1,395 sq ft and possession in December 2027.

Yes. A French-themed villa community is coming soon. You can register interest on the upcoming projects page to hear about launches first.

Yes. Triton projects are designed as comfortable homes while being positioned in locations with strong appreciation and rental demand.

North Bengaluru is growing rapidly due to the airport corridor, metro expansion, IT parks, Aerospace SEZ, business parks and major infrastructure projects, making it one of the most promising real estate markets in India.

Triton’s airport-corridor projects are just 3 – 6 km from Kempegowda International Airport, with seamless access to NH-44, STRR, the Aerospace SEZ and major employment hubs.

Triton projects sit in corridors with strong rental demand from aviation, aerospace and tech employment. Humming Valley also offers a rental model for owners; speak to our sales team for current terms.
